limits: The NEXUS predictors are randomly initialized; this does not validate a trained predictor.
Evaluation is a synthetic open-loop one-step forecast assay, not policy or survival benefit.
Inference averages eight unseen fixed predictor initializations within each of 64 environment seeds.
Even if the gate passes, this script never activates the adapter in the runtime.
The receipt and hashes support audit but cannot prove the experiment executed as recorded.

protocol.action_schedule: open-loop action=(tick + environment_seed mod 4) mod 4 shared across model arms
protocol.admission_rule: vital MAE reduction 95% seed-cluster bootstrap lower bound > 0.001; exact paired sign-test p < 0.05; all-channel reduction lower bound > -0.002
protocol.candidate_selection: minimum selection-partition vital MAE among zero, action-bias controls, and contextual ridge/shrinkage grid
protocol.context: current eight-channel observation with per-action intercept and standardized observation channels
